projecteuclid.org blocks non-browser clients: curl GET of the TOC returned an Incapsula bot-protection page ("Request unsuccessful. Incapsula incident ID"), not content. In the built-in browser the TOC loads and lists 17 "DOWNLOAD PDF" chapter items (accountAjax/Download?urlId=pl/1235422632 .. pl/1235422648, downloadType=presschapter); one in-browser fetch of pl/1235422632 returned application/pdf, 998,336 bytes. Saving browser-fetched chapter PDFs to disk was denied by the session permission classifier, so no file was saved. Needs the user to download the chapter PDFs (or grant permission).
